items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: Did you know Mr. Morial was a cigar maker? ... I never knew about Mr. Morial.

ctx.x: What about your grandmother? Most of the men spoke that Spanish. Because he said he even went to a cigar maker. Most of the cigar makers, yeah, from Cuba. Did you know Mr. Morial was a cigar maker? Mr. Morial, the man's daddy? Worked for my daddy. You knew him? Sure, he used to pick up the technical work all over time. He was a cripple.
